classification.difficultyReason: Rewrite equivalent addition and subtraction expressions using the touching-sign rules, including reversing a single operation into two signs.

inlines.text: Fill in the table. If you see a single sign, rewrite as two signs.

answer.worked:
Subtracting a positive number is adding its negative.
$$\begin{align*}4-3&=4+(-3)\end{align*}$$

Two minus signs rewrite as addition.
$$\begin{align*}2-(-4)&=2+4\end{align*}$$

Subtracting a positive number is adding its negative.
$$\begin{align*}(-2)-3&=(-2)+(-3)\end{align*}$$

Subtracting a positive number is adding its negative.
$$\begin{align*}(-4)-2&=-4+(-2)\end{align*}$$

Different touching signs rewrite as subtraction.
$$\begin{align*}5+(-2)&=5-2\end{align*}$$

Different touching signs rewrite as subtraction.
$$\begin{align*}4+(-3)&=4-3\end{align*}$$
